lab.requests: 145 core requests logged across the two api boots: 127x200, 4x201, 1x204, 6x304, 3x401, 1x403, 3x503. ZERO 429s, but rate limiting was DISABLED in this lab (RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED=false), so that is not a limits observation
lab.teardown: core api, the Next standalone server, the proxy, redis and postgres all stopped; the postgres data directory, the redis directory, the media root and the built binary removed

ruling_1_live_capability.rule: features.live = the live_enabled setting AND the boot ingest capability, the shape import_http / channel_sync / transcription / transcoding / messaging / messaging_e2ee / mail already report
ruling_1_live_capability.capability_predicate: liveIngestConfigured() = strings.TrimSpace(cfg.LiveRTMPURL) != "" — the same predicate config.Load derives the Go default from (LiveEnabled: p.Bool("FEATURE_LIVE_ENABLED", liveRTMPURL != "")). /admin/infrastructure's live row REUSES this helper for the ingest half of its `configured` column; it keeps its stricter reading (RTMP URL AND LIVE_HLS_ROOT) because that column means the whole plane is wired, while the create gate only needs somewhere to publish
ruling_1_live_capability.shared_helper: internal/httpapi/admin_instance_settings.go liveAvailable() / liveIngestConfigured(), consumed by instance.go (features.live), live.go (the create gate) and admin_infra.go (the capability row)

observations.state: live_enabled setting ON (PATCH, value=true overridden=true), no LIVE_RTMP_URL
observations.message: live streaming is turned on but this instance has no RTMP ingest to publish to. Set LIVE_RTMP_URL (and LIVE_HLS_ROOT, so the segments the media server writes can be served) and restart the api

admin_infrastructure_live_row.note: Live streaming is off. Turning it on needs an RTMP media server as well as the toggle: LIVE_RTMP_URL for streamers to publish to and LIVE_HLS_ROOT for the segments it writes.

observations.live_enabled_row: value=true default=true overridden=true — the DERIVED default moved with the env, the row still won the value

admin_infrastructure_live_row.note: Live streaming is on but the ingest plane is incomplete: LIVE_RTMP_URL tells streamers where to publish and LIVE_HLS_ROOT is where the media server writes segments. Without both, streams can be created and never started.
admin_infrastructure_live_row.comment: LIVE_HLS_ROOT was deliberately left unset, to show the admin row's stricter reading is intact and coherent beside the narrower create gate

That is harmless for the other three feature seeds, whose fallback equals their Go default; live's Go default is DERIVED, and the pin shadowed the derivation

findings_recorded_not_fixed: POST /live/{id}/key (regenerate) still returns a fresh key with an empty rtmp_url when no ingest is configured. It is only reachable on an instance that was wired and then unwired, and gating it would strand an operator mid-repair, so it is recorded rather than widened

the imports and auto-caption boot-capability 503s are bare echo.NewHTTPError, so the central 5xx scrubber replaces their operator-facing sentence with 'an unexpected error occurred'. Only live's new one is typed (LiveNotConfiguredError, the mail_not_configured precedent)
the auth wordmark is text only — it does not use the operator's uploaded header_wide / header_square logos the way Header.tsx does

the local-storage variable is STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT, as the ADM-04 section already records; LOCAL_STORAGE_ROOT is silently ignored and the store falls back to ./data/media relative to the process cwd. Re-observed this session (the lab was started with the wrong name and grew a ./data directory)

for_adm04_and_a05.adm04: the single-process lab here is NOT enough for ADM-04 — it needs the two-process topology from the config-truth slice, because the whole open half is worker visibility. What this run adds: GET /admin/instance-settings reports key/type/value/default/overridden/page/section and STILL says nothing about which processes read a key or its refresh tier, and a settings default that is DERIVED from env (live_enabled) is indistinguishable in that payload from a hardcoded one — an operator reading the API cannot tell that live_enabled's default moved because LIVE_RTMP_URL was set. If ADM-04 touches that endpoint, that is a cheap row to add
for_adm04_and_a05.a05: the lab ran with no SMTP at all and never needed one: owner claim, login and the admin PATCH surfaces are all reachable without mail. A05 will need MAIL_ENABLED + a relay (or the DEV_MAIL_CAPTURE_ENABLED seam the backed CI lane uses) before it can see a verification or reset link, and TOTP enrolment needs MFA_KEY_KEK or FEDERATION_KEY_KEK set or secrets are stored raw with a boot warning
